font.reason: The source is a restrained research-project UI. Vazirmatn variable supplies readable Persian at small card sizes, supports the source regular/bold hierarchy, and covers Persian digits, punctuation and ZWNJ. FaRoot loads the font before capture.

rtlDecisions.action: Set each recreated page to direction:rtl and right-aligned title, description, metadata, counters and tags.
rtlDecisions.why: These are product-page reading sequences, so their start edge is the right edge in Persian.

rtlDecisions.action: Moved the source top-right age stamp to top-left; kept the completion badge at the right/start side.
rtlDecisions.why: The stamp is trailing metadata, while status is the first item in the header reading order.

rtlDecisions.action: Put labels on the right, values on the left, and let counters read right to left. Converted all visible digits to Persian.
rtlDecisions.why: These are textual sequences; Persian readers scan them from the right. Numeric values retain their own digit order.

rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored navigation, section labels and search icons inside the recreated tall index and narrow search slice.
rtlDecisions.why: Those controls follow the page reading direction.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept the physical column order and source direction signs [-1,1,-1].
rtlDecisions.why: The wall is a centered parallax tableau. Alternating vertical movement is its defining motion, not a horizontal reading cue.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept perspective 1000px, rotateX 20deg, ticker scale 1.2, 200px top/bottom fades, column width 560px, gap 30px, loops [12,9,14] seconds and linear camera scale 1.0 to 1.06.
rtlDecisions.why: These are physical depth and timing parameters from the source prompt; none carries RTL reading meaning.

translatedElements: Ten source-specific project titles and descriptions
Ten sets of owner/customer/field metadata and research/experiment/paper counters
Ten relative-age stamps and pairs of tags
Completion badge on the fifth card
Project-index navigation, total count, search field and four category headings
text.typography: No letter spacing, uppercase transform or per-character splitting. Persian punctuation, digits and ZWNJ are used in the live UI.

rasterHandling.origin: The twelve work/persian/src/workbench/public/textures/live PNGs were SHA-256 compared against work/upstream/src/demos/_textures and were byte-for-byte identical. The upstream component referenced textures/<file>, absent from this workbench; the prior localization pointed to the matching live copies.
rasterHandling.action: Replaced every displayed raster with a live Persian React page slice in PersianPages.tsx. PNGs are reference material only. The ten compact cards reproduce title/description/metadata/counter/tag hierarchy; the tall index reproduces sparse navigation, search and category sections; the narrow slice remains a search field. No blur or baked foreign text is rendered.
rasterHandling.geometry: Each replacement uses its source PNG width/height ratio: two 714-or-716 by 576 cards, eight 714-or-716 by 624 cards, one 3840 by 3492 index and one 2032 by 88 search bar. This preserves item heights at the 560px ticker width and the seamless -50% period.

comps.timing: No frame timing, fps, duration, easing, loop direction or transform parameters changed. Persian text is static within moving slices, as in the source; there is no typing or stagger count to retime.

verification.sourceCodeAndPrompt: Compared the localized components with untouched upstream files and read the source prompt. All motion parameters and exported names remain unchanged.
verification.sourceAssetComparison: Viewed the original project cards, tall index and narrow search texture; confirmed all twelve live texture copies match upstream source assets by SHA-256.
verification.originalFrameComparison: Unavailable: work/upstream/out/video/demo-PageWaterfallWall.mp4 is absent, so the harness emitted no orig stills. No same-frame source-video visual comparison is claimed.
verification.visualFindings: Inspected frames show readable Persian cards with recognizable page outlines, RTL metadata, Persian digits, intact three-column depth and opposing vertical flow. No legible foreign text or text overflow was seen within visible card areas.

concerns: The upstream source MP4 is absent. Source-frame fidelity approval must wait for an original render or equivalent source-frame evidence; this card should not be marked published from these results alone.

lessons.symptom: Replacing a mixed screenshot wall with generic equal-height mock cards changes the ticker period and can break its -50% seamless loop even when loop code is untouched.
lessons.cause: This asset set mixes 576px and 624px project cards with a 3492px-tall index and an 88px-high search slice.
lessons.fix: Preserve each original asset's intrinsic width/height ratio in its live Persian replacement; verify the wall at multiple beats and render the full loop.
